name: MQTT Bridge — Agent Mesh
description: Agent Mesh Protocol v1.2 over MQTT — durable push connection (persistent session, QoS 1), owner-scoped job dispatch, HTTP control API and SSE-backed web panel. Capability-agnostic: services are data, not code. Works behind NAT (outbound connection only).

url.description: MQTT broker URL (e.g. mqtt://localhost:1883 or mqtts://broker.emqx.io:8883)

clientId.description: MQTT client ID. MUST be stable across restarts or the persistent session (clean:false) is defeated and messages queued while offline are lost. Defaults to openclaw-mqtt-bridge-<hash of host+install path>. Set explicitly only if you run two gateways from the same install directory.

protocolVersion.description: 4 = MQTT 3.1.1 (default, widest broker compatibility). 5 = MQTT 5, which adds a bounded session expiry so decommissioned deployments stop accumulating queued messages.

sessionExpirySeconds.description: MQTT 5 only: how long the broker retains our queued messages while disconnected.

agentId.description: This agent's id within the mesh.

servicesFile.description: Path to the capability catalog. Defaults to services.json beside the plugin. Watched via fs.watch; edits republish the retained profile.

requireOwner.description: Reject invokes with no requestedBy, as protocol 1.2 requires, instead of silently routing them to owner "public". Set false to accept unowned invokes with a warning.

verifyOwner.description: Verify requestedBy against a broker-injected client_username (EMQX rule-engine payload enrichment). Fails closed: with this on, an invoke lacking client_username is rejected. Requires broker-side setup first.

maxJobDurationMs.description: Hard wall-clock cap per job before the mesh publishes a terminal timeout error.

enabled.description: Serve the control panel and HTTP API.

path.description: Base path for the panel and its API.

auth.description: Bearer token required for the panel and API. Accepted as an Authorization header, or as ?token= for the SSE stream (EventSource cannot set headers). Unset means no authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session used by the legacy fallback dispatch path when the subagent runtime is unavailable.
